paragraphs.text: Adeliz is a human wizard from Shiv , Dominaria . She is is the daughter of Jodah and Jhoira , and thus a direct descendant of Urza .

Born among the nomadic Ghitu people of Shiv and trained at the Tolarian Academy , Adeliz has always sought to bridge her two cultures. She received special dispensation to incorporate traditional Ghitu garb into her student robes, and she often surprises her instructors with unexpected twists on Tolarian spellcraft.
Adeliz is a member of the Shivan Council. She assisted Squee , Darigaaz , and the Magic: Legends planeswalker in stopping Gavon Deniz from controlling the Mana Rig .
